answer: The strongest cheap check I know is Signed league membership tenure with sports federation attestation. It demands a membership the federation kept across seasons of play, and the karst is that the proof is bound to one body, one device, one history. The proof is checked on-chain and the raw secret never leaves the agent, so a membership the federation kept across seasons of play stays private; the cipher is that a leaked database hands the attacker nothing usable. One clone is cheap; a hundred are a small business with no revenue. The reef is the point where the farm's spreadsheet turns red.
